rows: Who may change ticket automation settings (archiving, spam, parent/child)

The default Agent profile has "automation", "featureConfig" and 39 other Setup permissions off; only Recycle Bin, import history, move records, snippets and masking are on. Not tried as an agent (the test org has one admin user).
Agent C (Desk Agent, no settings permissions) sees the page with every switch enabled.
Settings need a Setup permission the Agent profile does not have.
PUT archive / spam / parent-child settings as agent C → 200 each (existing values written back). GET support plans as agent C → 403, so other settings pages are protected.
